text:
Maya: Heads-up — LyraNet agreed to a 30m on-camera interview Wed Apr 10 11:00am PST. We need: release form signed, final quote approved, edited 60s clip, transcript, and embargo lift date. Can legal + CS confirm?

Sophie: Awesome. I'll own logistics and pull the transcript. Can we record via Zoom? LyraNet prefers Zoom recording.

Aj: Routing note — we'll feed inbound leads from the webinar to AJ SDR queue. Need opt-in checkbox on release to allow marketing outreach.

Maya: Yes — must include opt-in. Draft release: 
```
Redwood Inference and affiliates are permitted to use the interview recording, quotes, and transcripts for marketing and promotional purposes worldwide in all media. Customer retains right to review quotes for factual accuracy before publish.
```

Leo: Looping in legal. Quick Q: "affiliates" broad — we usually restrict to "Redwood Inference and its agents". Also need endorsement clause and ability to redact sensitive customer data. I'll post a redline in ~2 business days.

Leo: Also need customer name and logo usage approved — please confirm exact entity name and trademark.

Sophie: I'll request the signed logo/brand guidelines and confirm entity: LyraNet, Inc.

Rahul: For assets: we'll need a 6-8s hero clip, two 30s social cutdowns, and a still frame (jpg) from recording. Who will do edit? Marketing or LyraNet?

Maya: Marketing will handle edit. Sophie pls ask LyraNet for background b-roll and a point-of-contact for quick approvals.

Sophie: On it. ETA for signed release: Tue Apr 9 EOD. Transcription + raw recording will land in Google Drive — I'll post link here.

scheduling-bot: Calendar invite created: LyraNet interview — Wed Apr 10 11:00am PST — https://cal.example.com/meet/xyz :spiral_calendar:

Maya: Checklist (current):
- [ ] Release form signed
- [ ] Quote approval (customer review)
- [ ] Recording done
- [ ] Transcript + redlines
- [ ] Produce hero clip + social cutdowns
- [ ] Legal sign-off
- [ ] Publish plan + inbound routing

Sophie: Quick note re quote approvals — LyraNet wants to approve quote verbatim before publish. Suggest sending them the Q&A snippets we plan to use (1-2 lines each).

Aj: Also confirm webinar/web-promo cadence: we plan a 2-week teaser then publish? If so, route inbound to AJ queue for 30 days post-publish.

Maya: Yes 2-week lead time. Rahul — timeline for assets?

Rahul: I can turn demo cuts in 3 business days after receiving raw. So if recording Wed Apr 10, deliverables by Fri Apr 12 COB. :ok_hand:

Leo: I'll upload a redline of the release in the thread tomorrow. Please don't share any clips externally until legal + customer sign-off. :warning:

Maya: Great — thanks team. Sophie, ping here when signed release is in. We'll sync on a final publish date once legal approves.

Sophie: Will do. Thanks everyone! :partyparrot:
